sentiment.label: risk_on
sentiment.reason_it: Il VIX è a 14,87 (‑5,11% sett.) e resta sotto 18, segnale di mercato difensivo limitato. L'S&P 500 ha guadagnato +1,21% nella settimana, il DXY è sceso a 100,97 (-0,32%) indicando un dollaro più debole, mentre il Brent è crollato del -6,19% e il Gold è in ribasso del -2,34%. Nonostante il rialzo dei rendimenti US 10Y (+3,72%) e il leggero calo del TLT, la pressione su risk assets è contenuta e il sentiment settimanale è passato da risk_off a risk_on, con i giorni più recenti (sabato) in zona risk_on.
sentiment.reason_en: The VIX sits at 14.87 (‑5.11% weekly) and stays below 18, indicating limited defensive pressure. The S&P 500 posted a +1.21% weekly gain, the DXY fell to 100.97 (-0.32%) showing a weaker dollar, while Brent slid -6.19% and Gold is down -2.34% weekly. Although US 10Y yields rose (+3.72%) and TLT slipped slightly, risk assets face modest pressure and the weekly sentiment moved from risk_off to risk_on, with the latest day (Saturday) in risk_on territory.

market_impact_summary.it: Equity: S&P 500 +1,21%, Nasdaq +2,06%, STOXX 600 +0,62% – trend positivo. Fixed Income: US 10Y +3,72% spinge il TLT a -0,13% (bearish). Commodities: Brent -6,19% (bearish), Gold -2,34% (mixed). Valute: DXY -0,32% (bullish per EM). Crypto: Bitcoin +4,15% (bullish). La combinazione di VIX basso, dollaro debole e oil in forte ribasso sostiene un bias risk‑on, ma l’aumento dei rendimenti e il calo del TLT introducono una nota di cautela.
market_impact_summary.en: Equities: S&P 500 +1.21%, Nasdaq +2.06%, STOXX 600 +0.62% – clear upside. Fixed Income: US 10Y +3.72% pushes TLT down -0.13% (bearish). Commodities: Brent -6.19% (bearish), Gold -2.34% (mixed). FX: DXY -0.32% (bullish for EM). Crypto: Bitcoin +4.15% (bullish). The mix of low VIX, weaker dollar and sharp oil decline underpins a risk‑on bias, while rising yields and a slipping TLT add a hint of caution.

As recently as two years ago, their destination – a hi-tech weapons facility opened this month – had been a cornfield. Now, as Poland drives up defence investment at one of the fastest rates in the developed world, this rural spot has been transformed amid Europe’s response to Russian aggression and US disengagement.
